_meta.source: specs/formulas.md 'Global defaults' table and section notes; NEPRA Performance Standards (400/230 V, 50 Hz); rho_copper and rho_aluminium from IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G (rho1 = 1.25 x rho20 at working temperature)
_meta.status: Engineering defaults, every one editable on the page. Items marked engineer_confirm need PEC engineer sign-off before launch.

pf_by_load_type_source: Design power factor of an appliance circuit when none is entered (wiring pages, E4): inverter ACs about 0.9 (PFC drive), non-inverter compressors 0.8, resistive heaters (geyser, kettle, iron, heater) 1.0 (pure resistance, same as pf_resistive; Engineer Reviewer 2026-10-15); engineer to confirm
soiling_rate_max_per_day_source: Upper guard for the dust-loss input (5% of output a day, far above the 0.3%/day planning rate and reported dust-storm losses) so a percent typed as a share (0.3 for 0.3%) is rejected; engineer to confirm
ac_life_years_source: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Applications, Owning and Operating Costs chapter, median service life of residential single or split package air conditioners (15 years); N10 reports no payback when the payback is longer than this (audit WL-22); engineer to confirm
decision_years_source: Comparison period of the Home Power Decision Engine (H1): ten years covers one LiFePO4 battery life and three tubular lives (data/backup-prices.json battery_life_years); editable on the page
dc_ac_ratio_max_source: Typical string/hybrid inverter DC/AC oversize 1.1-1.3 (manufacturer datasheets' maximum recommended PV input, e.g. 130% of rated AC power); engineer to confirm
forecast_max_day_whm2_source: Plane-of-array daily irradiation above about 9 kWh/m2 does not occur at Pakistani latitudes (clear-sky maximum); 12,000 Wh/m2 is a safety cap against bad forecast data; engineer to confirm
